note_on_what_this_dataset_is: the earlier part of the same 2026-11-02 day as the strata-20261102-config-sweep dataset: 24 engine sessions between 09:33 and 15:17 local, 16 of which carried --mtp and for which ten MTP outcomes were logged, and in which the KV quantization, vision state and pool settings differ from the evening sweep. configuration.difference_from_the_evening_sweep_datase: the evening dataset used --kv q4_0 with --vision absent, and six of its eleven launches used --spec 6 while five used --spec 4; this dataset used int8 or k8v4 KV, vision enabled in 20 of 24 sessions, and --spec 4 in all 24. Cross-dataset comparisons are therefore confounded on at least three variables.

records.note_on_counting: a prompt record is a line of the form 'prompt N tokens = R reused + F read …'; 8 further event lines begin with 'prompt chunk auto:' and are NOT prompt records. The 183 prompt records split as: 42 cold (reused = 0), of which 20 have prompts under 1 000 tokens and 8 of those are literally 'prompt 53 tokens'; 136 warm (reused > 0); and 5 cut-off prefills of the form '0 reused + 46914 of 190804 read … 0 generated in 0 ms'. Completed = 42 + 136 = 178. 'Excluding short warm-ups' means prompt length under 1 000 tokens, i.e. 22 + 136 = 158

The highest log_line published in this file is 12 623; 12 626 is the end of the extracted window, not a published record
source_excerpt.selection_rule: narrower than the evening sweep's whitelist: engine_start, 'strata generate: expert cache N slots', 'strata serve: prompt chunk auto', 'strata mtp: draft layer loaded', 'strata serve: prompt N tokens = …' and 'strata generate: mtp:'. It deliberately does NOT include the 'KV streaming:', 'decode expert cache hit rate:' or 'conversation cache:' request counters that the evening dataset publishes, so hit-rate and KV-spill figures cannot be derived from this file
source_excerpt.program: see extract.awk in this directory. Its whitelist is narrower than the evening dataset's: engine_start lines; 'strata generate: expert cache N slots'; 'strata serve: prompt chunk auto'; 'strata mtp: draft layer loaded'; 'strata generate: mtp:' (MTP refusal and dense-weights allocation failure); 'strata serve: prompt N tokens = …'. It deliberately omits the 'KV streaming', 'decode expert cache hit rate' and 'conversation cache' counters
source_excerpt.program_note: run it as: printf 'kind\tlog_line\tengine_started_local\tpayload\n' > engine-metrics.tsv, then awk -v lo=9470 -v hi=12626 -v R="$INSTALL_ROOT" -f extract.awk "$ENGINE_LOG" >> engine-metrics.tsv. The install root is passed in at run time, so neither this manifest nor the program contains an absolute personal path. Syntax note: conditions are kept on one line because the default awk on this host is mawk, which rejects a condition continued across lines. Re-running the committed program reproduced this TSV byte for byte at 15 693, at 17 233, at 18 689, at 19 664 and at 20 648 log lines (see line_anchors_reverified)

limitations: this is not a controlled experiment; it is the recorded history of interactive configuration attempts made during a working day

the KV quantization (int8 / k8v4 / q4_0), the vision state and --spec differ between sessions in this window and between this window and the evening sweep, so cross-session comparisons are confounded on several variables at once
five launches failed on unknown arguments (--kv-streaming, --draft-vocab), which shows the configuration was being edited by hand against a moving engine interface
no peak RAM or VRAM was sampled
prompt identity across sessions is inferred from exact token-count matches, not from published fixture hashes
the draft-acceptance totals for the 10:00:17 and 11:34:58 sessions are sums of the engine's own per-request counters, not an independent measurement

draft-acceptance counters also appear in the no-MTP sessions of this window, so 'no MTP' is not 'no drafting'; **what the drafts are drawn from is not established by published data** — prompt-suffix lookup is the engine's own description in a private help dump (gap G12) and is recorded as a hypothesis (X), not as a fact
the 189737-token cold prefill record is a single run at 254.3 tok/s in an MTP session; it is the longest completed cold prefill in this dataset and it is unreplicated
five prompt records in this dataset are cut-off prefills that generated nothing; they are published for completeness and are excluded from every throughput statement in this repository
